notes: Access route: same as bs96/na96 -- Tier 1 (curl_cffi, 14 profiles) and Tier 2 (headless Playwright) both hit DataDome (403 JS-challenge / CAPTCHA iframe) on /c/ listing pages; used Tier 3 Claude-in-Chrome (real browser) to complete the task. Checked GREAT DEALS/BONS PLANS mega-menu and the dedicated SECONDE CHANCE/SECOND CHANCE top-nav item (French AND local terms: soldes, destockage, fin de serie, outlet, derniere(s) piece(s), braderie -- none of 'soldes'/'destockage'/'fin de serie' appear anywhere in the nav). Two genuinely different Clearance-type listings found and BOTH kept as separate rows per brief (different URLs, different product sets/counts, neither an alias of the other): (1) 'Braderie' (reached via GREAT DEALS > "Jusqu'a -50% sur nos dernieres pieces*") -- page breadcrumb/H1 render in English as 'Clearance sale', each product carries an on-card 'CLEARANCE SALE' (BRADERIE) badge, filters are Category/Color/Matter/Dimensions/Price only (no condition facet) -- this reads as new catalog stock permanently marked down, i.e. a classic Clearance/outlet listing. No flag needed. (2) 'Seconde Chance' (Second Chance), a dedicated top-nav section (own dropdown with 8 category shortcuts that are facet links into the same underlying listing, not separate PLPs) -- its main listing 'Tous les produits Seconde Chance' shows permanent discount vs a struck-through 'Neuf' (new) price AND has its own 'Etat' (condition) facet with grades Tres bon etat / Bon etat / Etat satisfaisant / Etat correct, i.e. it is a graded used/returned/ex-display resale channel rather than a listing of new discontinued stock. This is genuinely ambiguous against the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance test (permanent-markdown signal present, but the goods are condition-graded second-hand items, not new end-of-line stock), so it is recorded with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than a unilateral include/exclude decision. EXCLUDED as generic temporary promos (no permanence signal, no clearance/outlet taxonomy label): 'Jusqu'a -15% de remise immediate*' (sitewide threshold discount code), 'Jusqu'a -20% sur nos best-sellers chaises*' (temp promo on a chair subset), 'Jusqu'a -20% sur tout le linge de maison*' (temp category-wide promo), 'La rentree de nos marques partenaires - Jusqu'a -50%' (seasonal partner-brand campaign), and 'Tous nos bons plans' which resolves to /edito/code-promo-maisons-du-monde, an editorial promo-codes hub page with no product grid.
